threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think ‘Dagenham’ is a nice place for a day out; seasoned locals know that's just a long way to a regretful night.
Had a bloke debate the merits of Jerk Chicken vs. KFC while the bus was stuck in traffic on Coldharbour Lane. Only in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a family of ducks waddling through the Reuterplatz flea market, completely unfazed by the bustling crowd.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you get an 'intergalactic' falafel sandwich from a food truck parked next to a techno club, blasting beats at noon.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a true local by their reaction to the smell of burnt toast from BART delays—most just roll their eyes and keep walking.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading commuters with a ukulele at the Civic Center stop while BART was down. Only in SF do delays come with live music.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars serve tapas, but many local spots focus on vermut and olives instead. It's a whole different vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still ask for 'tapas' instead of 'pintxos' when they’re in a bar; locals don’t mix the terminology.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You think the number 55 bus goes to nowhere until you realize it stops at every local pub for a pint break.
Last night on the 77, a bloke serenaded us with an off-key rendition of 'Wonderwall' while a cat meowed in response. Only in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I realized I was home when I saw the street performer with a saxophone and a cat on a leash jamming at Hermannplatz. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find currywurst with a side of Turkish tea at 3 AM. It’s a late-night cultural fusion you won’t forget.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s local when they can tell you the real reason why BART's always late—it's never just about the equipment problems.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo on the 14 Mission, giving a spontaneous toast to commuters. Only in SF would formal wear meet the 7 AM grind.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think Gràcia's all about the plazas; but look closer and you'll find hidden murals in the alleys that tell stories no guidebook mentions.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’ll be the ones still fumbling with the metro map, staring at it like it's a treasure map, while locals swipe their cards without a second thought.
